description: Use this whenever the customer asks about SERVICE, maintenance, repairs, oil changes, tires, brakes, batteries, recalls, warranty work, a check-engine light, or booking a service appointment. Returns the official J.C. Lewis scheduling link (per-store when `store` is given, otherwise the group scheduler that lists every location), plus the service address and phone. Pass mobile=true if the customer wants a technician to come to their home or office (Ford Mobile Service). NEVER quote service hours, wait times, repair prices, or specific appointment availability — only the scheduler knows real availability. Hand the customer the link.
name: schedule_service
